scripts.prepare: command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.predev: pnpm run sync:prompt && ((lsof -ti:3001,5173 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null) || true) && pnpm run dev:setup
scripts.dev:setup: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-mines-ai} sh -c 'docker compose up -d postgres && until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U mines_ai -d mines_ai >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} pnpm run db:migrate'
scripts.dev:serve: concurrently -k --kill-signal SIGKILL -n api,client -c blue,green "DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} APP_DATABASE_URL=${APP_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} tsx watch src/index.ts" "pnpm run client:dev"
scripts.dev:serve:local: concurrently -k --kill-signal SIGKILL -n api,client,sandbox -c blue,green,magenta "DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} APP_DATABASE_URL=${APP_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} tsx watch src/index.ts" "pnpm run client:dev" "SANDBOX_MODE=local SANDBOX_PORT=${SANDBOX_PORT:-8888} SANDBOX_WORKSPACE_DIR=${SANDBOX_WORKSPACE_DIR:-data/sandbox-workspace} pnpm --filter sandbox dev"
scripts.dev:tunnel: if [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN:-}" ]; then cloudflared --config /dev/null tunnel run --token "${CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN}" --url http://127.0.0.1:3001; elif [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG:-}" ]; then cloudflared --config "${CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG}" tunnel run; else echo "Missing CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN (preferred) or CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG for SANDBOX_MODE=gce" >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.dev:proxy:tunnel: if [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_TUNNEL_TOKEN:-${CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN:-}}" ]; then cloudflared --config /dev/null tunnel run --token "${CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_TUNNEL_TOKEN:-${CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN}}" --url http://127.0.0.1:${LITELLM_PROXY_PORT:-4000}; elif [ -n "${CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_CONFIG:-${CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG:-}}" ]; then cloudflared --config "${CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_CONFIG:-${CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG}}" tunnel run; else echo "Missing proxy tunnel config: CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_TUNNEL_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARED_PROXY_CONFIG (or fallback to CLOUDFLARED_TUNNEL_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARED_CONFIG)" >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run client:build
scripts.lint: pnpm run sync:prompt:check && biome check . && pnpm run lint:sandbox
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:client && pnpm run typecheck:sandbox
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U mines_ai -d mines_ai >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.test:e2e: (lsof -ti:3001,5173,8888 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null) || true && docker compose up -d postgres && DATABASE_URL=${E2E_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} pnpm db:migrate && E2E_DATABASE_URL=${E2E_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mines_ai:mines_ai_password@localhost:5435/mines_ai} playwright test
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm --filter mines-ai-commons-client test && pnpm --filter sandbox test
scripts.test:full: pnpm run test:all && pnpm run test:e2e
